target.title: fix(runtime): guard JSON.stringify against circular tool output
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`writeRuntimeJson()`, the runtime `writeJson` method, and the plugin SDK `createLoggerBackedRuntime` all call `JSON.stringify(value)` on arbitrary tool return values. Circular references cause `TypeError: Converting circular structure to JSON`, crashing the output path.

Improves on the contributor fix in #99490. The original fix used `String(value)` as the sole fallback, which ClawSweeper found can still throw for null-prototype circular objects (`Object.create(null)` with circular refs → `Cannot convert object to primitive value`).

## Root Cause

Three call sites in `src/runtime.ts` and `src/plugin-sdk/runtime-logger.ts` stringify unknown runtime values with unguarded `JSON.stringify(value, null, space)`:

| Call site | File | Line (HEAD) |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `createRuntimeIo().writeJson` | `src/runtime.ts` | 84 |
| `writeRuntimeJson` log fallback | `src/runtime.ts` | 116 |
| `createLoggerBackedRuntime().writeJson` | `src/plugin-sdk/runtime-logger.ts` | 31 |

`JSON.stringify` throws synchronously on circular structures, and there is no catch. The tool return value flows through these paths unchecked.

## Why This Change Was Made

Extracted a pure `safeJsonOutput(value, space?)` helper in `src/runtime.ts` that never throws:

1. `JSON.stringify(value)` — normal path
2. Catch → `JSON.stringify(String(value))` — handles ordinary circular refs
3. Catch → `"[unserializable]"` — last-resort for null-prototype objects where even `String()` throws

Key design decisions:
- **Serialization separated from I/O**: The helper returns a string; `writeStdout()` and `logger.info()` are called outside the try-catch. This preserves the existing EPIPE/EIO handling in `writeStdout`.
- **Shared across all call sites**: The plugin SDK `runtime-logger.ts` imports the same helper, so the three identical bug surfaces share one defensive path.
- **Nested try-catch, not replacer-based**: `JSON.stringify` replacer cannot intercept circular references (the engine throws before calling the replacer), so a catch-based fallback chain is the only reliable approach.

## Changes

- `src/runtime.ts`: +21/-9 lines
  - Added exported `safeJsonOutput(value, space?)` helper with nested try-catch
  - `createRuntimeIo().writeJson` → `writeStdout(safeJsonOutput(value, space))`
  - `writeRuntimeJson` log fallback → `runtime.log(safeJsonOutput(value, space))`
- `src/plugin-sdk/runtime-logger.ts`: +2/-1 lines
  - Import `safeJsonOutput`; `createLoggerBackedRuntime().writeJson` → `logger.info(safeJsonOutput(value, space))`
- `src/runtime.test.ts`: +48/-2 lines
  - 5 new `safeJsonOutput` unit tests + 6 `writeRuntimeJson` tests (rewritten)
- `src/plugin-sdk/runtime.test.ts`: +24 lines
  - 2 new tests for logger-backed runtime circular + null-prototype paths

## Evidence

### Verification environment

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| OS | Linux 4.19.112 x86_64 |
| Node.js | v22.19.0 |
| Vitest | v4.1.8 |

### Unit tests (15/15 passed, 7 new)

```
src/runtime.test.ts (11 tests)
 ✓ safeJsonOutput > serializes plain objects with default spacing
 ✓ safeJsonOutput > serializes compact without space
 ✓ safeJsonOutput > serializes with custom space
 ✓ safeJsonOutput > falls back to String(value) for circular references
 ✓ safeJsonOutput > falls back to constant for null-prototype circular references
 ✓ writeRuntimeJson > serializes plain objects via writeJson
 ✓ writeRuntimeJson > handles circular references via writeJson
 ✓ writeRuntimeJson > handles null-prototype circular references via writeJson
 ✓ writeRuntimeJson > delegates to runtime.log when writeStdout is absent
 ✓ writeRuntimeJson > falls back to String(value) in log path for circular references
 ✓ writeRuntimeJson > falls back to constant in log path for null-prototype circular references

src/plugin-sdk/runtime.test.ts (4 tests)
 ✓ resolveRuntimeEnv > returns provided runtime when present
 ✓ resolveRuntimeEnv > creates logger-backed runtime when runtime is missing
 ✓ resolveRuntimeEnv > handles circular references in logger-backed writeJson  ← NEW
 ✓ resolveRuntimeEnv > handles null-prototype circular in logger-backed writeJson  ← NEW
```

### Real-process proof: all 5 code paths (production code, no mocking)

Standalone script imports the production `safeJsonOutput`, `createNonExitingRuntime`, `writeRuntimeJson`, and `createLoggerBackedRuntime` via `tsx`. No mocking — real Node process running the actual production code paths.

```
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
OpenClaw Runtime JSON Guard — Real-Process Verification
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PID:       <redacted>
Node:      v22.19.0
Platform:  linux x64

── Path A: safeJsonOutput (pure serializer) ──
  normal  : {"ok":true}
  circular: "[object Object]"
  null-ptr: "[unserializable]"
  Result:  PASS

── Path B: defaultRuntime (writeStdout path) ──
  normal  : {
  "status": "ok",
  "count": 3
}
  circular: "[object Object]"
  null-ptr: "[unserializable]"
  Result:  PASS

── Path C: writeRuntimeJson → writeJson (output delegation) ──
  circular → "[object Object]"
  null-ptr → "[unserializable]"
  Result:  PASS

── Path D: writeRuntimeJson → runtime.log (log fallback) ──
  normal  : { "key": "value" }
  circular → "[object Object]"
  null-ptr → "[unserializable]"
  Result:  PASS

── Path E: createLoggerBackedRuntime (plugin SDK logger) ──
  normal  : { "plugin": "test", "value": 42 }
  circular → "[object Object]"
  null-ptr → "[unserializable]"
  Result:  PASS

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
VERDICT
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  Normal objects serialized correctly                     PASS
  Circular refs → "[object Object]" (no crash)            PASS
  Null-proto circular → "[unserializable]" (no crash)     PASS
  writeStdout path handled                                PASS
  runtime.log fallback handled                            PASS
  Plugin SDK logger-backed runtime handled                PASS
  All 5 code paths exercised. No TypeError thrown.
```

### Comparison: PR #99490 vs this fix

| Scenario | `main` | #99490 `String(value)` | This PR |
|----------|--------|------------------------|---------|
| Normal `{ok: true}` | ✅ JSON | ✅ JSON | ✅ JSON |
| Circular `a.self = a` | ❌ TypeError | ✅ `"[object Object]"` | ✅ `"[object Object]"` |
| Null-proto circular | ❌ TypeError | ❌ TypeError | ✅ `"[unserializable]"` |
| Pipe error (EPIPE) | preserved | swallowed by catch | preserved |

## User Impact

- Prevents runtime crash when tools return objects with circular references
- The CLI outputs a safe fallback string instead of crashing
- Transparent to users; no config changes required
- Pipe-closed errors (EPIPE) continue to be handled correctly — the serialization catch does not interfere
